blocks.heading: Different ways in. The same attention to detail.
body: Compare payment types before considering an offer. Availability, fees and processing times depend on the operator and your location.
Crypto payments can involve network fees and price changes. A supported payment method is not evidence of licensing or suitability.

blocks.heading: A little context goes a long way.
body: Understand a welcome offer|A larger headline does not tell the whole story. Compare the wagering basis, eligible games and expiry before making a decision.
Choose a payment method|Look beyond the deposit. Check withdrawal methods, identity checks, limits and any fees.
Set your boundaries|Decide your time and spending limits before playing. Gambling is entertainment, never a source of income.

blocks.heading: Clarity is our starting point.
body: Read the conditions|Bring the terms, deposit requirements and payment options into the same view.
Compare what matters|Filter by your preferences instead of relying on a headline bonus or an unexplained score.
Keep the context|This is a design demonstration. All operators, offers and comparisons shown here are fictional.

items.question: Can I play on MODEL?
items.answer: No. MODEL is a fictional comparison demonstration, not a casino. It does not accept deposits or offer real gambling.

items.question: Are these real casino offers?
items.answer: No. Every operator and offer is sample content. No commercial relationships or verified rankings are implied.

items.question: How is the catalogue ordered?
items.answer: The default is an explicit demo display order, not a quality rating. You can also sort by minimum deposit or name.

items.question: Does crypto mean a casino is regulated?
items.answer: No. Payment support alone does not establish whether an operator is authorised for your location.

items.question: What should I check before playing?
items.answer: Check the requirements for your location, the operator’s authorisation, full terms, withdrawal conditions and responsible-play tools.

blocks.heading: Play should stay in perspective.
blocks.body: Set a limit. Take a break. Never chase a loss. This demonstration is intended for adults aged 19 and over; actual requirements depend on your location.
